notes.title: Now with music!
notes.notes: I was unhappy with the lack of music in ZOOMnBOOM, but I didn't think there was much I could do about it since I'm not much of a musician. Then I found some music by [url=https://soundcloud.com/punch-deck]Punch Deck,[/url] which they kindly decided to release under the Creative Commons license. I'd say it makes my game about 72.6% better.

notes.title: New VR mode
notes.notes:
An optional VR mode has been added. Press F11 on the title screen initialize your headset, then press F11 again to toggle VR on and off.

I cannot guarantee the contents of your stomach will remain there if you jump while driving upside-down.
